title: Dave Velk - 5-Star
htmlContent:
Showcasing a different style than we are used to, Dave Velk released “5-Star” as his last track. Dave Velk is an artist that’s been known to channel his emotion into his music.

His unique vocal style and ability to connect with his listeners have certainly set him apart from other artists. The melodic composition and energetic production of “5-Star” will surely leave you wanting to come back for more.

Stream the song below and be sure to follow Dave Velk on all social media platforms.
